extraction.Name: Lizzie Guerue
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 25, 1920 by the Fenners State Bank of Kilgore
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739611 issued; southwest quarter of section 5, township 35, range 32; receipt for patent signed by the allottee April 2, 1920; on May 4, 1920 Lizzie Guerue Quigley, formerly Guerue, and James Two Horse or Quigley conveyed the land to Victor Hoffman
